description: Mashup Pon di Road July 19 + July 19 Mashup Pon di Road MASHUP PON DI ROAD is a bashment circus on a big truck—an outdoor, vaudeville-style, West-Indian flavoured, black girl-powered variety show pulling up on city streets.
